subject: maths
question: M can do a piece of work in (39/2) days and N in (13/2) days. How many days will both take together to complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

M can complete the work in 39/2 days.

N can complete the work in 13/2 days.

**Formula used:**

Work done in one day = 1 / Time taken

Total time when working together = 1 / (M's one-day work + N's one-day work)

**Calculation:**

M's one-day work:

⇒ Work = (1)/(39/2) = (2)/(39)

N's one-day work:

⇒ Work = (1)/(13/2) = (2)/(13)

Combined one-day work:

⇒ Work = (2)/(39) + (2)/(13)

⇒ Work = (26 + 78)/(507) = (104)/(507)

Total time to complete the work:

⇒ Time = (1)/(104/507) = (507)/(104) = **(39)/(8)**

**∴ Both M and N will take 39/8 days to complete the work together.**
